title: Staccato Loxapine Pulmonary Safety in Patients With COPD
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the pulmonary safety of 2 doses of Staccato Loxapine within a day in patients with COPD.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* History of COPD for at least 6 months with pre-bronchodilator FEV1 ≥40% of predicted value and \>15 pack-year history of cigarette smoking.

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of asthma, or any other acute or chronic pulmonary disease.
